build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template using define_task_template decorator with seed and version parameters
add_dynamic_ball: create a dynamic ball object in the scene with a specified scale and center position
add_static_bar: add a static bar to the scene with configurable scale, position, and alignment properties
add_dynamic_jar: create a dynamic jar container object with set center x and bottom position constraints
update_task_relationships: update the task to define spatial INSIDE relationship between a ball and target jar
